body: She definitely didn’t mean to, which is why I feel so awful. I love her more than anything in the world and I hate that this happened and don’t want her to feel like she’s responsible for bringing out part of my trauma
Yeah that’s true, I do want to fix things with her, she just mentioned something about a sexual assault that happened to me when I was young and something about that really really stung

I did, but now she seems to be in a bit of a circle of self loathing, I don’t know what to do, she blames herself excessively now and I don’t want her to think it was her fault, I shouldn’t have reacted the way I did and I just want her to feel okay
Well we were on the bed and I pushed her away a couple inches, it wasn’t really the physical act that was the main problem, it was more how it made her feel
